exclusion_detail: Lead 19g needs 5 reactions: Corey-Chaykovsky epoxide (1 to 2), epoxide opening with MeNH2 (2 to 3), Suzuki coupling of 6 with boronic acid 16g (to 17g), ester hydrolysis (to 18g), and amide coupling of 18g with 3.

lead.label: 19g
lead.why: Abstract: 'compound 19g is a triazole antifungal compound with 4-chloro-2-fluoro phenylthiophene backbone, which showed optimal antifungal activity ... MIC80 0.0625 ug/mL'.
